title: GTA was born from a bug

segments.text: One of the biggest video game series ever made only exists because of a bug. That series is Grand Theft Auto.
In {1995,|nineteen ninety five,} a small studio in Dundee, Scotland, started a game called {Race'n'Chase.|Race and Chase.} You played as a cop, chasing criminals.
But it was dull. The game kept crashing, the cars handled terribly, and it was almost cancelled.
Then a glitch in the police code made the cop cars way too aggressive. Instead of blocking you, they rammed you off the road.
The team loved it, so the bug stayed. And the idea flipped. Nobody wanted to be the cop. You became the criminal.
Grand Theft Auto came out in {1997.|nineteen ninety seven.} Its violence caused so much outrage that the controversy became free advertising.
And now, almost thirty years later, Grand Theft Auto {VI|Six} arrives on November {19th.|nineteenth.} All because some cops wouldn't stop chasing.
